example: Spanish contractors moved more of their purchasing online in 2024.

writing_rule: Start with the actor's name (the slide has no separate actor box). What they did or announced, past tense. No judgment adjectives.
example: Hierros García launched an online steel marketplace in Spain in March 2025.

writing_rule: What came of it, only as a source reports it. "[Publisher] projects" for a forecast. When no source reports a result, write "Not yet reported"; the line is then hidden on the slide.
